points.title: 童年与早期教育
points.description: 1799年5月20日，巴尔扎克出生于法国图尔的一个中产阶级家庭。他的父亲是政府官员，母亲来自富裕的资产阶级家庭。1814年，随着拿破仑帝国的崩溃，全家迁往巴黎。在图尔的这段时期，巴尔扎克接受了传统教育，但表现出对文学的特殊兴趣。他大量阅读古典文学作品，尤其是拉封丹和莫里哀的作品，这些早期阅读经历深刻影响了他后来的文学风格和创作主题。
points.descriptionEn: Born on May 20, 1799, in Tours to a middle-class family, Balzac's father was a government official while his mother came from a wealthy bourgeois background. In 1814, following the collapse of Napoleon's empire, the family moved to Paris. During his time in Tours, Balzac received traditional education but showed a special interest in literature. He extensively read classical works, particularly those of La Fontaine and Molière, which profoundly influenced his later literary style and thematic concerns.

points.title: 法律学习与文学尝试
points.description: 1814年，巴尔扎克随家人迁居巴黎，进入法律学校学习。然而，他对法律的兴趣有限，更热衷于文学创作。1820年，他开始以笔名发表作品，包括诗歌和小说。1825年，他尝试出版一部小说并投资印刷业，但以失败告终，使他陷入债务困境。这段时期，他经历了多次失败，但也积累了丰富的社会观察和人生经验，为他后来的创作提供了素材。他开始构思《人间喜剧》的宏大计划，试图全面描绘法国社会。
points.descriptionEn: Moving to Paris in 1814, Balzac attended law school but showed limited interest in law, being more passionate about literary creation. In 1820, he began publishing works under pseudonyms, including poetry and novels. In 1825, he attempted to publish a novel and invest in printing, but failed, plunging him into debt. During this period, he experienced multiple failures but accumulated rich social observations and life experiences that provided material for his later works. He began conceiving the grand plan for 'La Comédie Humaine,' aiming to comprehensively depict French society.

points.title: 创作高峰与债务危机
points.description: 1826年至1832年是巴尔扎克创作生涯的关键时期。他开始以真名发表作品，创作了《驴皮记》等早期代表作。这一时期，他生活极其拮据，经常负债累累，甚至不得不躲债。为了偿还债务，他疯狂写作，每天工作16小时以上，靠浓咖啡提神。1830年七月革命后，他敏锐捕捉到社会变革，开始系统性地创作《人间喜剧》系列作品。这一阶段的作品奠定了他作为现实主义文学大师的基础，但也使他陷入更深的债务危机，不得不不断寻求出版商的预付款。
points.descriptionEn: From 1826 to 1832 was a crucial period in Balzac's literary career. He began publishing under his real name and created early masterpieces like 'The Magic Skin.' During this time, he lived in extreme poverty, often heavily in debt, and had to evade creditors. To repay his debts, he wrote frenetically, working over 16 hours daily sustained by strong coffee. After the July Revolution of 1830, he keenly captured social changes and began systematically creating the 'La Comédie Humaine' series. Works from this period established him as a master of realistic literature but plunged him deeper into financial crisis, forcing him to constantly seek advances from publishers.

points.title: 《人间喜剧》体系构建
points.description: 1833年，巴尔扎克开始系统构建《人间喜剧》这一宏大的文学体系。他计划创作137部作品，包括小说、随笔和戏剧，全面描绘法国社会的方方面面。这一时期，他创作了《欧也妮·葛朗台》《高老头》等经典作品，塑造了一系列令人难忘的人物形象。他经常在夜间写作，白天则拜访各色人物，收集素材。1842年，他发表了《人间喜剧》前言，详细阐述了这一文学体系的构想。这一阶段，他的创作达到巅峰，作品质量与数量惊人，但也使他的健康状况急剧恶化。
points.descriptionEn: In 1833, Balzac began systematically constructing the grand literary system of 'La Comédie Humaine.' He planned to create 137 works, including novels, essays, and plays, comprehensively depicting all aspects of French society. During this period, he wrote classics like 'Eugénie Grandet' and 'Father Goriot,' creating a series of unforgettable characters. He often wrote at night and spent days visiting various people to collect material. In 1842, he published the preface to 'La Comédie Humaine,' elaborating on the concept of this literary system. This phase marked the peak of his creativity, with astonishing quantity and quality of works, but also led to a rapid decline in his health.

points.title: 晚期创作与逝世
points.description: 1843年至1850年是巴尔扎克生命的最后阶段。尽管健康状况严重恶化，他仍然坚持创作，完成了《贝姨》《邦斯舅舅》等重要作品。1846年，他被授予法国荣誉军团勋章，但拒绝接受，认为这会损害他的艺术独立性。1848年革命期间，他支持共和派，但反对暴力。1850年8月18日，巴尔扎克因心脏并发症在巴黎逝世，年仅51岁。他的葬礼上，维克多·雨果发表了著名的悼词。巴尔扎克的逝世标志着19世纪法国现实主义文学的一个重要转折点，他的作品对后来的文学发展产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: From 1843 to 1850 was the final stage of Balzac's life. Despite severe health deterioration, he continued to write, completing important works like 'Cousin Bette' and 'Cousin Pons.' In 1846, he was offered the Legion of Honour but refused it, believing it would compromise his artistic independence. During the 1848 revolution, he supported the Republicans but opposed violence. On August 18, 1850, Balzac died of cardiac complications in Paris at the age of 51. At his funeral, Victor Hugo delivered a famous eulogy. Balzac's death marked a significant turning point in 19th-century French realistic literature, and his works had a profound influence on subsequent literary development.

appraisal.zh: 巴尔扎克被公认为现代现实主义文学的奠基人，《人间喜剧》以宏大规模细致呈现19世纪法国社会全貌，其实地考察与社会分析的方法为后世作家树立典范，作品至今仍是研究法国社会史的重要资料。不过也有研究者指出，他的小说常显冗长拖沓，人物塑造时有夸张，对金钱地位的执迷与摇摆的政治立场削弱了批判力度，其个人生活亦存争议。
appraisal.en: Balzac is widely regarded as the founder of modern realistic literature; La Comédie Humaine renders 19th-century French society on a grand scale, and his methods of field research and social analysis set an example for later writers, his works remaining key sources for French social history. Yet researchers also note that his novels are often long-winded, his characters sometimes exaggerated, and that his fixation on money and status and shifting politics weakened his critical edge, while his personal life remains controversial.

supporter.zh: 巴尔扎克被誉为现代现实主义文学的奠基人，他的《人间喜剧》系列作品以其宏大的规模和深刻的社会洞察力，开创了文学创作的新纪元。他通过细致入微的描写，展现了19世纪法国社会的全貌，从贵族到平民，从巴黎到外省，无所不包。他的创作方法——实地考察、人物素描和社会分析——为后来的作家树立了典范。巴尔扎克不仅是一位文学巨匠，更是一位社会学家，他的作品至今仍被研究法国社会史的重要资料。
supporter.en: Balzac is hailed as the founder of modern realistic literature. His 'La Comédie Humaine' series, with its grand scale and profound social insight,开创ed a new era in literary creation. Through meticulous descriptions, he presented a comprehensive panorama of 19th-century French society, covering all classes from aristocrats to common people, from Paris to the provinces. His creative methods—field research, character sketches, and social analysis—set an example for later writers. Balzac was not only a literary giant but also a sociologist whose works remain important resources for studying French social history.

critic.zh: 批评者指出巴尔扎克的创作存在明显的局限性。他的作品常常过于冗长，情节拖沓，人物塑造有时显得刻板和夸张。此外，他对金钱和地位的痴迷反映了他自身的价值观矛盾，有时使作品显得功利主义。他的政治立场也摇摆不定，从保皇派到共和派，缺乏一致性。一些评论家认为他的作品虽然描绘了社会现实，但缺乏真正的批判精神，反而强化了某些社会不平等。他的个人生活也备受争议，包括与韩斯卡夫人的长期婚外情。
critic.en: Critics point out several limitations in Balzac's work. His novels are often excessively long with meandering plots, and his characterizations can sometimes appear stereotypical and exaggerated. Additionally, his obsession with money and status reflects his own value contradictions, sometimes making his works seem utilitarian. His political stance was also inconsistent, shifting from royalist to republican without clear consistency. Some critics argue that while his works depicted social reality, they lacked true critical spirit and instead reinforced certain social inequalities. His personal life was also controversial, including his long-term extramarital affair with Madame Hanska.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，巴尔扎克被定义为19世纪法国社会的忠实记录者和批判者。他的作品不仅是文学经典，也是研究法国社会史的重要文献。在流行文化中，巴尔扎克的形象常常与咖啡、深夜写作和不懈追求联系在一起，成为艺术家奋斗精神的象征。他的创作方法影响了后来的自然主义文学和现实主义文学流派。尽管存在争议，巴尔扎克的作品仍被广泛阅读和研究，他对人物心理和社会环境的深刻描绘使他成为世界文学史上不可或缺的重要人物。
objective.en: In academic and popular culture, Balzac is defined as a faithful recorder and critic of 19th-century French society. His works are not only literary classics but also important documents for studying French social history. In popular culture, Balzac is often associated with coffee, late-night writing, and relentless pursuit, becoming a symbol of artistic struggle. His creative methods influenced later literary movements like Naturalism and Realism. Despite controversies, his works continue to be widely read and studied, and his profound depictions of character psychology and social environments make him an indispensable figure in world literary history.

self.zh: 天才就是耐心的同义词。
self.en: Genius is the infinite capacity for taking pains.
